articles.title: How Twitter Scales Its Home Timeline: Fan-Out on Read vs Fan-Out on Write
articles.excerpt: Imagine opening Twitter (now X). Your home timeline shows tweets from hundreds or thousands of accounts you follow, sorted by time. Seems simple, right? But think about the scale: Millions of users ac…
articles.body: Imagine opening Twitter (now X). Your home timeline shows tweets from hundreds or thousands of accounts you follow, sorted by time. Seems simple, right? But think about the scale: Millions of users accessing their timelines. Millions of tweets being published. Every user follows a different set of accounts. Some accounts have millions of followers. How do you generate everyone's timeline efficiently? Martin Kleppmann discusses this interesting problem in Chapter 1 of Designing Data-Intensive Applications (DDIA) . Let's understand the approaches. The Problem Suppose Alice follows 1,000 accounts. Whenever Alice opens her home timeline, the system needs to fetch recent tweets from those accounts, combine them, sort them, and display them.
articles.author: kevinrawal

Hardware for AI 09. Experiments and Benchmarks 09.01 Hardware Benchmarks 하드웨어 벤치마킹(Hardware Benchmarking)은 인공지능(AI) 하드웨어 플랫폼(Hardware Platform)의 연산 능력(Computational Capability), 효율성(Efficiency), 운영 특성(Operational Characteristics)을 체계적으로 평가하는 방법을 제공한다. 이론적 사양(Theoretical Specifications)과 달리 벤치마크(Benchmark)는 정의된 작업 부하(Workload)와 실행 조건(Execution Conditions)에서 성능을 측정한다. 이를 통해 CPU, GPU, TPU, NPU, FPGA 및 학습(Training)과 추론(Inference)에 사용되는 특수 가속기(Specialized Accelerator)를 의미 있게 비교할 수 있다.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.body: STATERA Library · Volume 39 · Chapter 08 · KR Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/01_Vol_39_Hardware_for_AI/blob/main/Chapter_08_Engineering_and_Deployment/Chapter_08_Engineering_and_Deployment_KR.md Volume 39. Hardware for AI 08. Engineering and Deployment 08.01 Hardware Selection Strategy 하드웨어 선택(Hardware Selection)은 인공지능(Artificial Intelligence, AI) 시스템의 성능(Performance), 확장성(Scalability), 신뢰성(Reliability), 운영 효율성(Operational Efficiency)을 결정하는 핵심 엔지니어링 의사결정이다. 효과적인 선택 전략은 애플리케이션 요구사항(Application Requirements)을 측정 가능한 하드웨어 사양(Hardware Specifications)으로 변환하는 과정에서 시작된다. 단순히 최대 연산 성능(Peak Computational Performance)만을 기준으로 장치를 선택하기보다는 작업 부하(Workload), 메모리 용량(Memory Capacity), 데이터 이동(Data Movement), 전력 소비(Power Consumption), 배포 제약조건(Deployment Constraints) 사이의 전체적인 관계를 평가해야 한다.

articles.body: This is a simplified guide to an AI model called Xtts-V2 maintained by Lucataco . If you like these kinds of analysis, you should join AImodels.fyi or follow us on Twitter . Overview xtts-v2 is a multilingual text-to-speech model from lucataco that clones voices using only a 6-second audio sample and synthesizes speech in 17 different languages. Built on Coqui's XTTS-v2 architecture, this model powers production services including Coqui Studio and the Coqui API. The single most important thing to know is that you need a clean audio reference sample—ideally 6 seconds of clear speech—to achieve high-quality voice cloning; the model includes a denoising option to handle noisier microphone recordings, but input quality directly affects output quality.

Hardware for AI 07. Hardware Software Co Design 07.01 Co Design Principles 하드웨어-소프트웨어 공동설계(Hardware-Software Co-Design)는 컴퓨팅 하드웨어(Computing Hardware)와 소프트웨어 알고리즘(Software Algorithms)을 독립적으로 최적화하는 대신 함께 개발하는 체계적인 공학적 접근 방식이다. 인공지능(AI) 시스템에서 이러한 접근 방식은 모델 아키텍처(Model Architecture), 처리 장치(Processing Unit), 메모리 계층 구조(Memory Hierarchy), 실행 프레임워크(Execution Framework)를 정렬하여 지연시간(Latency), 처리량(Throughput), 에너지 소비(Energy Consumption), 비용(Cost), 신뢰성(Reliability) 등의 실제 제약 조건에서 효율적인 성능을 달성하도록 한다.

articles.title: Hardware for AI — Ch.06: Advanced AI Hardware [KR]
articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Volume 39 · Chapter 06 · KR https://github.com/Statera-Library/01_Vol_39_Hardware_for_AI/blob/main/Chapter_06_Advanced_AI_Hardware/Chapter_06_Advanced_AI_Hardware_KR.md Volume 39. Ha…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Volume 39 · Chapter 06 · KR Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/01_Vol_39_Hardware_for_AI/blob/main/Chapter_06_Advanced_AI_Hardware/Chapter_06_Advanced_AI_Hardware_KR.md Volume 39. Hardware for AI 06. Advanced AI Hardware 06.01 Neuromorphic Computing 뉴로모픽 컴퓨팅(Neuromorphic Computing)은 생물학적 신경계(Biological Nervous Systems)의 구조와 작동 원리에서 영감을 얻은 대안적인 인공지능 하드웨어(Artificial Intelligence Hardware) 접근 방식이다. 순차적 또는 대규모 병렬 산술 연산을 통해 명령어를 실행하는 기존 프로세서(Conventional Processor)와 달리, 뉴로모픽 시스템(Neuromorphic System)은 분산 연산(Distributed Computation), 이벤트 기반 통신(Event-Driven Communication), 지역 메모리(Local Memory)를 강조한다. 이러한 구조는 희소 활성화(Sparse Activity)와 시간적 동역학(Temporal Dynamics)을 활용하여 정보 처리 효율성을 높이는 것을 목표로 한다.

articles.body: Nvidia has launched an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang after he admitted to having an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. The tech giant's board confirmed the news in a statement today, saying that it is looking into its concerns "in light of recent reporting" that Huang has "been the target of a foreign intelligence effort." The update follows a late-October New York Times report , which stated the CEO had been unfaithful to his wife with an individual that U.S. intelligence believed to be involved in a Chinese spy plot. The individual named in the report as having a relationship with Huang was Megaspeed executive and Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang or Huang Le. The CEO confirmed the affair in a letter sent to Nvidia staff (via BBC ).

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 8, 2005: Europe launches Venus Express, its first mission to Venus
articles.excerpt: On Nov. 8, 2005, Europe launched its first mission to Venus. Here's why Venus Express mattered.
articles.body: On Nov. 8, 2005, Europe launched its first mission to Venus. The spacecraft was called Venus Express. Venus is a hothouse planet, one where the atmospheric pressure can easily crush an unprotected spacecraft. Even from orbit, Venus Express had to survive harsh radiation. But the spacecraft lasted for more than nine years. During that time, Venus Express saw a weird vortex swirling around Venus's south pole . It also saw possible signs of active volcanoes . Venus Express also discovered that the planet generates its own auroras . These auroras happen when particles from the sun hit charged particles in the atmosphere. Late in the Venus Express mission, controllers told the spacecraft to dip down into Venus's clouds — even though the spacecraft wasn't designed to do this.

articles.title: Who is King Ghidorah? The cosmic connections of Godzilla Minus Zero's foe
articles.excerpt: Godzilla will go toe-to-toe with long-time foe King Ghidorah in Godzilla Minus Zero. This three-headed Kaiju's origins aren't just space-based; one of the largest structures in the universe shares its…
articles.body: Godzilla goes toe-to-toe with long-time foe King Ghidorah in Godzilla Minus Zero, which opened in theaters on Friday (Nov. 6). Though the three-headed golden Kaiju might seem like a natural native of Monster Island, King Ghidorah actually emerged from the depths of space. However, it isn't just the origins of King Ghidorah — also known as Monster Zero in the Godzilla movie Invasion of Astro-Monster (1965) — that are this beast's only cosmic connection. One of the largest structures in the universe, the King Ghidorah Supercluster , was named in honor of Godzilla's primary antagonist. Eat that, King Kong!

articles.title: Scientists simulate an Earth without life to help hunt for aliens and inhabited worlds
articles.excerpt: By modeling how a planet without life develops its atmosphere, astronomers hope to be able to better distinguish rocky planets without life from those that are inhabited.
articles.body: A new computer simulation that depicts Earth, or a rocky planet in general, without life is the latest tool in the quest to discover whether or not we are alone in the universe. Life leaves its mark on a planet, particularly its atmosphere, in the form of a mixture of biochemically created gases. Some are obvious, while others can be produced by both biology and geology, meaning that distinguishing a planet that has life from one that does not, solely based on what gases we can detect in its atmosphere, can be difficult. The key is in knowing which atmospheric conditions can be explained without life.

articles.body: If you follow the EV industry in North America, you’d be forgiven for thinking that the future of transportation revolves around electric SUVs and pickups. Every week seems to bring another teaser from a startup promising to reinvent the family car or truck. The latest electric SUVs, “coming soon” tiny trucks, lifestyle trucks, modular trucks, etc. Companies like Slate, TELO, and countless others have generated plenty of excitement, even if many of them still have everything left to prove. Don’t get me wrong – I hope they succeed. We need more affordable electric vehicles.
